notes: Setup is now four steps and starts in Google Sheets: Make my copy → 🏠 HouseRunner → ▶ HouseRunner – SETUP. When the window says Published ✅, Open HouseRunner brings you to the website already connected, for Welcome, Your family and Connect your screen and phones. No more tabs to juggle.
The SETUP window in your Sheet now waits by itself if Google’s Apps Script API switch needs turning on, and carries on as soon as it’s on.

Your family now includes the licence key (filled in from your email) and the calendar, which is set up automatically from the family’s names – fine-tune it later in Screens. Free API keys are optional and added later in System → API keys.
